title: KinderCare Awards $100,000 in Scholarships to Former Students Pursuing Two- or Four-year College, University or Vocational Program
summary: LAKE OSWEGO, Ore., August 06, 2026--KinderCare Learning Companies, Inc. (NYSE: KLC) ("KinderCare"), a leading provider of high-quality early childhood education and care, today announced the recipients of its 2026–27 KinderCare Learning Companies’ Kids Scholarship. KinderCare is awarding 20 former students with $5,000 scholarships to support their education at an accredited two- or four-year college, university or vocational program.
